title: The Equinoctial Threshold
hardCanon: The Threshold is one of eight Fae portals and is hidden under a forest hill.
Boggart magic opens the entrance briefly at night and seals visitors inside during the day.
Laidre the Duskkiller cannot leave the Threshold because of a curse following Ste. Brumaire's death.
The goblin Night Market does not trade in ordinary coin and can charge currencies such as luck, faces, time and talents.
The party's selected motive does not erase the other factions, objects or possible goals.

objectiveOptions.label: Acquire a peculiar item from the Night Market
Plunder Laidre's vault for the rumoured Gloomblade
Avenge Ste. Brumaire on behalf of the Church
Find passage from the mortal world to the Fae
Destroy the Boundary Stone and send away the Threshold/Night Market

rumours.claim: The legendary Gloomblade is in Laidre's vault.
rumours.aiRule: Present as rumour until source evidence confirms or disproves it.

scenes.title: The Door Beneath the Ancient Tree
requiredFacts: The entrance is a stone door among ancient roots in a forest hill.
It opens only during a brief nightly window through Boggart magic.
Entering may leave the party sealed inside during daylight.

suggestedChoices.label: Wait for the nightly opening window
Inspect the stone door and surrounding roots
Prepare supplies and a plan before entering

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Creative interaction with the door is allowed, but source-defined Boggart access rules cannot be erased merely for convenience.

blockingUnknowns: exact entrance timing and time progression
